_readme: Single source for products, prices and stock. Templates and PHP read only this file.
Prices are in EUR with 2 decimals. Stock is a bottle count, edited by hand, then run build.
STOCK NUMBERS BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS until the final 2026 bottle count is known.
online=false means the product is shown but only for local pickup (OPEN: 1 L online or pickup only).
base_price / base_price_date: Croatian base price rule. Only shown when site.toml pricing.show_base_price = true.
Bundles: price null = sum of the bottles (no discount). Contents and prices are OPEN.
